archetype_description: Swiss Brutalist & High-Contrast mixed with Command Center (Performance Pro) for an elite, high-urgency aesthetic.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-black
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-bold transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold border border-border transition-colors

cards.default: bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl p-8 relative overflow-hidden group

sections.name: Header
sections.description: Sticky top nav. Glassmorphism to blur content underneath.
sections.layout: Flexbox, space-between. Logo left, Nav center (desktop), CTA right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Massive headline, tight tracking. Subtitle below. Two CTAs (Primary and Secondary). Background has the subtle texture. The right side (or center bottom) features the 3D interactive email sorting visualization.
features: 3D stacked cards using framer-motion and rotateX/rotateY

sections.name: LogoCloud
sections.description: Social proof. Muted logos with slow marquee.

sections.name: Interactive Demo / Features Bento
sections.description: Command Center visualization. Bento grid layout highlighting: AI Classification, Alarm Notifications, Phishing Detection, Auto-Replies.

sections.name: HowItWorks
sections.description: 3-step process (Connect -> Classify -> Notify) with sticky scroll or staggered reveal.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.description: 3-column pricing table (Free, Pro, Team). Monthly/Annual toggle. High contrast on the 'Pro' tier card with glowing 'Tracing Beam' border effect.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.description: Masonry or grid of quotes using the fetched avatar images.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Massive typography 'Ready to take control?'. Minimal links.

animations.hero_3d: Framer motion: initial={rotateX: 20, rotateY: -20, rotateZ: 5, y: 50, opacity: 0}, animate={rotateX: 15, rotateY: -15, rotateZ: 0, y: 0, opacity: 1}, transition={duration: 0.8, ease: 'easeOut'}
animations.scroll_reveal: Framer motion: whileInView={opacity: 1, y: 0}, viewport={once: true, margin: '-100px'}

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Manrope' fonts by adding the font_imports to your global CSS and defining them in your tailwind config.

The Hero section must contain an interactive 3D visualization. Use Framer Motion's style={{ rotateX, rotateY }} or transform properties to stack 3-5 'Email Cards' that animate sorting into different priority buckets (Critical, Normal, Spam).
Implement the 'Tracing Beam' glowing border effect for the 'Pro' Pricing Card to make it stand out.
Bento grid for the Command Center must leave no empty spaces. Use col-span-2 and row-span-2 to create tension.
Ensure the hero background image has a max overlay opacity of bg-black/50, or a radial gradient so the texture remains visible.
Include data-testid on all buttons and interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='pricing-pro-cta').
Use the exact color palette defined in the JSON for the Tailwind config.
Avoid standard Bootstrap/Shadcn grid layouts for the marketing sections. Use asymmetrical grids and generous padding (p-12+).
Replace generic SaaS copy placeholders with strong, authoritative tone fitting the 'PrioMail AI' brand.
